description: This file defines the code-behind for the ExamResult page in an online examination system, handling page load event by retrieving session data, updating user info in the database, and displaying exam results and questions.

classes.name: ExamResult
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ExamResult ASP.NET page, handling page load logic and navigation button clicks.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, retrieves session data, updates user exam info in the database, and populates UI elements with session data.

methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the user profile page.
